bullets.content: cargo build --release fails with Access is denied on target/release/hive.exe while MCP servers run; use cargo check until sessions close.
When hive.exe is locked, rebuild anyway: rename target/release/hive.exe and run cargo build --release; old sessions keep the old binary.
Compute the parity sha with `ctx_execute` and pin it in a Rust test.
The shell blocks python -c; never inline code, use `ctx_execute` or a script file.
Never name a module trace.py or json.py; hive uses traces.py.
Keep traces.py and trace.py names distinct in hive imports.
Do not edit src/ace.rs parse rules or ace.py LINE_RE inline; older readers drop unknown lines.
Extend src/ace.rs parse and ace.py LINE_RE together so both readers stay in sync.
